description: SET identifier-11 TO LOCALE {LC_ALL | USER-DEFAULT}, ISO 14.9.39.2 Format 12 (save-locale) - introduced 2002 with the locale facility (Annex A.4.9 item 9; kb/Work PB64 T1): the current locale (GR26) or the user default (GR27) is saved and a reference to it - a managed saved-locale handle (DESIGN-locale-facility L4) - is placed into the data-pointer (SR28). Parse-arm gated on recognition (VisitSetLocaleStatement; the shape has no '85 reading).
vcr: 2002 introduction (the locale facility; kb/Work PB64 T1 - the saved-locale handle)
source:
